```text
# PR #2769: Patch: Stats Card Clarity

Closes #2756

## What changed

On `/stats`, the card breakdown dialog now lets you choose which art a full-art card's faces print. Examples are Gary the Gambler (`core-004`) and Big D-fender (`core-001`, listed as "Spark Pup" in the test fixtures).

- **The choice:** it offers **No full art**, **Epic**, **Legendary** and **Mythic**, as a button group above Show Radiant. The pressed button is the art both faces print, so the Radiant face follows it when Show Radiant is on.
- **Where it starts:** it opens on what the face printed before. That is Epic while the Full-art cards setting is on and No full art while it is off.
- **How long it holds:** the choice is kept from card to card, and over closing and reopening the dialog. This is the same way Show Radiant behaves. It is not stored in the address.
- **Cards without full art:** a card with no full art gets no choice, so its dialog is unchanged.
- **No pick written:** the choice writes no card pick. The faces are wrapped in `OwnCopy own` and `FullArtShown`, so the existing preview machinery applies it.
- **Ownership:** the page mounts no ownership provider, so every tier shows whatever the viewer owns, as the Almanac does.
- **Tokens:** a token listed under a full-art card reads its parent's arts. No token drill-down was exercised in the tests.

Files:
- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.tsx`: the `DrillDownArt` type, `ART_LABELS`, `artsOf`, `artPick`, the state, the wrapper and the button group.
- `apps/web/src/stats/testids.ts`: `drillDownArt`.
- `apps/web/src/routes/stats.test.tsx`: three new `R2756000` tests, and the Tab-trap test extended with the art buttons.
- `spec/rulings/R2756000.md` (new), `spec/pending/2756.md` (new), one sentence appended to the `spec/10-engine-guide.md` §10.10 full-art paragraph, and the "Where every full art shows" line in `spec/rulings/R1313000.md`.

Nothing under `apps/web/src/cards/` was touched. That keeps `classify` free of a `--visual` fragment (R2529000). There is no CSS change and no `zh-CN.json` change, because every label already had an entry.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

All of these come from the plan, and I followed it without departing.
- **Four options, not two.** I offer every tier, not a normal-or-full-art switch. A two-way switch would hide the Legendary and Mythic a player chases.
- **Held in page state, not the address.** The address would make the choice shareable, but Show Radiant is not carried there either.
- **All tiers shown, owned or not.** An owned-only list needs an ownership read that this public page does not make.
- **The normal option is labelled "No full art", not "Normal".** "Normal" is already the Radiant caption, and an existing test finds that caption with `getByText("Normal")`.
- **Scope.** I read "toggling between cards in the Stats page" as the card breakdown. The Cards tab's grid thumbnails still follow the Full-art cards setting. An art switch on the grid would be a follow-up.

## Tests I ran

- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/stats.test.tsx -t R2756000`: 3 passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/stats.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`: 67 passed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude …`, which is the harness's own selection: 30 files and 700 tests passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint` on the three touched web files: clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: ok (1604 rulings).
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`: `Internal`, no fragment needed.
- `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `cargo fmt --check`: clean.

I did not run clippy or the Rust tests, because no Rust source changed. I did build the wasm, which the web tests need.

## For the reviewer

- `OwnCopy own` is a deliberate white lie, so that `FullArtShown` applies (R1834000). It wraps only the `.stats-drilldown-faces` div. It is not around the Tokens list or the details. `CardFace`'s `worn` stays false, so no foil, finish or border is worn.
- `core-001` is a full-art card, so the existing Tab-trap test now walks four extra buttons. I extended it accordingly, in the same file.
```
